settings.founder_subheading: The story behind the brand, in our own words.
settings.brand_story_heading: An Indian celebration-wear brand for the world
settings.brand_story_text:
Janvi Aika is a premium Indian celebration-wear brand for women who want to feel confident, elegant, and unforgettable during life's most meaningful moments. Our collections include lehengas, graceful Anarkali suits, refined chudidhars, party wear, and one-minute sarees—each piece blending traditional craftsmanship with modern aesthetics.

We believe fashion is more than clothing—it is confidence, identity, and celebration. Our first store began in Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu; from there we grew a brand that reaches across India and connects with customers globally online.

Janvi Aika is led by Ms. Pradeepa Senthilkumar, who brings international perspective and a deep love of South Indian heritage. Her vision is a celebration-wear brand that feels both traditional and modern—so Indian outfits shine at parties, milestones, and celebrations everywhere, not only at rituals and weddings.

From fabric selection to finishing, every piece is carefully quality-checked—because celebration wear is not just worn for a day; it becomes part of your memories.
